thread:
Maria (partnerships): Heads-up: DBX <-> Qdrant connector scale QA showing inconsistent indexing latencies on large batches. Partner flagged customer POC failure. Can infra + eng-ml look? cc @Tom (Databricks) @Qdrant (partner-bot)
Lee (eng-ml): Seeing increased variance when batch size > 10k docs, looks like GC/IO spikes on the indexing worker. Sharing perf trace in a sec.
Priya (eng-platform): Which runs? point me to the harness id and we can repro on Dedicated cluster.
Tom (Databricks): We ran two POC jobs: job-82 and job-83 (same dataset). job-82 passed on our side but job-83 timed out during qdrant upsert. We suspect JVM/connector handshake timeouts.
Qdrant (partner-bot): qdrant-ops: matching logs uploaded to partner bucket: s3://qdrant-uploads/poc/176544/
Lee (eng-ml): Repro harness id: scale_harness_20260304_7. I'll kick a run against a 4x larger dedicated pool to isolate.
Anya (product): This blocks the co-announcement with Databricks if we can't guarantee 99% success on our marketplace tests. Please surface rollback or mitigation options ASAP.
Priya (eng-platform): Temporary mitigation: decrease default batch size for marketplace connector to 2k and increase upsert concurrency. Can push via feature flag for marketplace tier only.
Lee (eng-ml): Quick test of reduced batch size now.
Lee (eng-ml): ```yaml
# override for marketplace runs
connector:
  default_batch_size: 2000
  upsert_concurrency: 8
  retry_backoff_ms: 500
```
deploy-bot: feature-flag updated: marketplace_batch_override applied to service dbx-qdrant-connector by @Priya (eng-platform) :rocket:
Priya (eng-platform): Feature flag applied to canary. Starting 10m canary run.
Tom (Databricks): We'll mirror the same flag on our side and run the two POC jobs again. If you want, we can run a side-by-side on DBX managed clusters.
Lee (eng-ml): Canary looks stable so far, p95 indexing latency down 40%. Uploading traces: https://dash.redwood.internal/trace/scale_harness_20260304_7 (internal)
Qdrant (partner-bot): qdrant-ops: partner harness run results posted: https://partners.qdrant.co/runs/20260304/scale_report.pdf
Anya (product): If these numbers hold across DBX runs, we can proceed with a limited marketplace publish (beta tag) and include the batch-size note in release notes. Need marketing + legal sign-off but unblock technically.
Maria (partnerships): Good. Schedule a triage tomorrow 10am PT with Tom, Lee, Priya to confirm long-term fix and documentation. I'll draft the co-announcement note but mark it "requires final perf sign-off".
Priya (eng-platform): I'll add an automated alert on connector-index-p95 > 5s and a runbook step to flip the flag back if needed.
Lee (eng-ml): Filing a short post-incident with root-candidate: large-batch IO amplification on indexing worker. Will add mitigation and next steps.
Tom (Databricks): Thanks for quick action. We'll confirm our POC runs by EOD and share any JVM tuning we used.
Maria (partnerships): Perfect. Thanks team :thumbsup:
